wiki:
How to Obtain:

1) Private Farm recipe (requires 3 developed plots + minimum of 1 Farm producing Hemp)
2) Shipwreck (certain wrecks only and drop is not 100%)
3) Adventurer Advanced Award 1 - 3,500 Roman Coins; sold in Rome's Coliseum lobby (not always available; drop is not 100%)
4) Pet Search
